correctness.rationale: Direct finite no-self-interaction payoff expansion gives Delta_i; exact sums are ((2-T)(N-5)-6T)/6 and W=-(N^2+(2T-1)N-T+4)/6<0. Independent exact Fraction tests for N=2..60 and 81 tridiagonal numerical solutions passed.

value.rationale: For a continuous parameter family with exactly symmetric deterministic basins, the relative odds of rare mutant cooperator versus rare defector reverse at a sharp size N_*(T) for every selection intensity, while cooperation itself is always below neutrality. This simultaneously isolates a meaningful invasion-vs-neutrality distinction, not an arbitrary isolated parameter or a mere finite simulation.
